description: This file defines the class 'ZooKeeperClusteringProviderBuilder' which implements clustering provider builder interfaces for Orleans 'Silo' and 'Client' using ZooKeeper. It includes assembly attributes registering the provider for different roles and contains methods to configure clustering options with provided configuration sections.

classes.name: ZooKeeperClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: Internal sealed class implementing Orleans provider builder interfaces for Silo and Client, configuring ZooKeeper clustering based on provided configuration sections.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures an ISiloBuilder with ZooKeeper clustering options based on the provided configuration section.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures an IClientBuilder with ZooKeeper clustering options based on the provided configuration section.
